name: Juwairen L'Etranger
source:
This is an alternate-history visual novel based on the hyper-competitive high school experiences in East Asia.
During the Amenominakanushi economic boom, a young man arrived at the riverside city Eshiro. Crime, conspiracy, and love await...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078970/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一部架空历史视觉小说，取材于东亚竞争异常激烈的高中生活。
在经济繁荣的天御中景气时期，一名年轻人来到了江畔城市江城。等待他的，是犯罪、阴谋与爱情…

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078970/]Steam[/url]]
